ns2:course.label: Nuclear Power Econ & Fuel Mgmt
ns2:course.description: Quantitative analysis of the impact of the nuclear power industry; nuclear fuel cycle and capital costs for thermal and fast reactors; optimization of the use of nuclear fuels to provide the lowest energy costs and highest system performance; comparison between fossil fuel systems, fission systems, and controlled thermonuclear fusion systems. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Junior standing is required. Prerequisite: NPRE 402 or NPRE 247.
